name: WebsitePublisher AI
description: WebsitePublisher is an AI web-application platform. Claude builds and publishes complete sites and web apps - pages, data models, forms, integrations, and admin dashboards - directly from the conversation. Edit pages and assets, manage structured content, set up contact forms and visitor auth, and push changes live without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add WebsitePublisher AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add WebsitePublisher AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.websitepublisher.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the WebsitePublisher AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: WebsitePublisher AI lists 43 MCP tools, including configure_form, configure_visitor_auth, create_edit_session, create_page, create_project, create_scheduled_task, delete_asset, delete_page, delete_scheduled_task, entities, execute_integration, and fragments.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to WebsitePublisher AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to WebsitePublisher AI in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.

_published_faq.name: Does WebsitePublisher AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: WebsitePublisher AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
WebsitePublisher AI is developed by WebsitePublisher. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
